observations.note: Counts are an observation at survey time and may change immediately.

findings: Branch namespace is historical/experimental residue at a scale far larger than active attention; branch existence cannot be treated as queue state.
Generated COMMS/NEXUS snapshots consume a large fraction of exact master chronology. FIELD INDEX already de-emphasizes them, but previously mislabeled the first filtered field commit as HEAD.
Current authority is much smaller than repository address space: 12 retained heads versus 153 manifest routes.
PR #464 exposed a separate corruption class: valid feature-local tests can coexist with duplicated source after </html>; that class is now guarded by HTML document integrity validation.
The external/private ops-hub generator that writes COMMS/NEXUS snapshots was not accessible through the connected GitHub installation, so this pass does not pretend to change its cadence.
delta: Keep exact MASTER HEAD visible even when machine refresh commits are de-emphasized.
Expose FIELD latest as a separate semantic coordinate.
Encode branch-existence and generated-refresh authority boundaries for future agents.
non_actions: No branch refs deleted: branch deletion is unavailable in the connected tool surface and donor dependence was not exhaustively proved.
No generated refresh cadence changed: generator authority was not accessible.
No mass manifest hiding: discoverability and current attention remain separate concerns.
